channel.title: Blockfront
channel.description: Blockfront reports crypto news: Bitcoin and Ethereum, DeFi protocols, exchanges, regulation, security incidents, funding rounds and network upgrades.

item.title: Treasury orders U.S. firms to block MEXC transfers over $16B
item.description: FinCEN ordered U.S. financial firms to block transfers to and from MEXC, alleging the exchange handled at least $16 billion in illicit funds over five years.

item.title: Nigeria sets stablecoin licences, bans algorithmic tokens
item.description: Nigeria’s central bank set separate licences for naira and foreign-currency stablecoins, barred algorithmic tokens and gave operators 180 days to apply.

item.title: Samsung Wallet brings Solana USDC accounts to US Galaxy users
item.description: Samsung Wallet now lets eligible US Galaxy owners buy, hold and send USDC on Solana, adding stablecoin transfers and overseas bank payouts to the app.

item.title: cBridge Transfers and Withdrawals Put Different Checks on Users
item.description: cbridge transfers move assets between chains; exchange withdrawals send them to an address. The difference changes what you check, record and may owe in tax.

item.title: Binance says fake job interview preceded $6.34B hack
item.description: Binance says a fake recruitment process helped attackers compromise staff and steal $6.34 billion, exposing the exchange’s wallet systems.

item.title: Monad bridge transfers can leave users short of MON for gas
item.description: A monad bridge transfer can deliver an asset without the MON needed to move it again; here is how native gas, source fees and sponsorship differ.

item.title: Schroders brings emerging markets bond fund to Solana
item.description: Schroders and Centrifuge launched a tokenized feeder fund for the Emerging Market Bond strategy on Solana, giving investors onchain shares tied to emerging-market debt.

item.title: Binance details $6.34 billion security incident
item.description: Binance says its Oct. 29 wallet incident affected $6.34 billion, with $2.85 billion frozen; the exchange says it will cover losses as its review continues.

item.title: How to set slippage for frequent token swaps
item.description: Frequent token swaps need a slippage limit matched to liquidity and volatility: too tight can fail trades, while too loose can worsen the execution price.

item.title: Binance says fake job interview led to $6.3 billion hack
item.description: Binance says attackers used a fake job interview and compromised employee devices in a months-long campaign before draining $6.3 billion from its hot wallets.

item.title: Binance says hot-wallet breach cost $6.3 billion
item.description: Binance says attackers stole about $6.3 billion from its hot wallets on Oct. 29; it will cover the loss while partners freeze assets and probe the breach.

item.title: Binance says hot-wallet breach cost $6.3 billion
item.description: Binance says attackers took about $6.3 billion from hot wallets, with withdrawals returning in phases and the exchange covering losses as its investigation continues.

item.title: Binance says $6.3bn hack drained wallets; withdrawals paused
item.description: Binance says attackers drained about $6.3bn across ten blockchains; it has frozen roughly $3bn, reserved funds to cover losses and paused withdrawals.

item.title: Binance says $6.3 billion stolen in hot-wallet hack
item.description: Binance says attackers stole about $6.3 billion from its hot wallets; roughly $3 billion is frozen as the exchange moves to cover the losses.

item.title: Binance says security incident affected $6.3 billion
item.description: Binance says a security incident affected about $6.3 billion, with roughly $3 billion frozen as it investigates unauthorized withdrawals and works to restore service.

item.title: Binance estimates $6.3B impact from security incident
item.description: Binance estimates a security incident affected $6.3 billion and says partners froze about $3 billion while it investigates unauthorized withdrawals and suspends transfers.

item.title: xStocks tops $1 billion in assets under management
item.description: Payward says xStocks crossed $1 billion in AUM on Oct. 27, with more than 1,500 tokenized assets spanning global markets and expanding onchain access.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow, targeting 150-millisecond finality
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on Oct. 21, replacing TowerBFT with validator-to-validator voting designed to cut transaction finality from 12.8 seconds to about 150 milliseconds.

item.title: Omnichain apps move tokens and instructions across blockchains
item.description: Omnichain systems pass tokens or instructions between blockchains, but each transfer depends on verification, destination execution and the security of its route.

item.title: OCC rule leaves stablecoin rewards open to crypto exchanges
item.description: The OCC’s final GENIUS Act rule leaves exchanges room to pass stablecoin earnings to customers as rewards, while issuers remain barred from paying holders interest.
